summary: The proposed patch changes the serialization of Enum objects in migrations to use the name instead of the value. While this addresses the issue described, there are some concerns regarding potential regressions and test coverage.

issues.description: Changing the serialization format from `Status('Good')` to `Status['GOOD']` may break existing migrations that rely on the current behavior. This could cause issues for users who have already applied these migrations.
The PR does not include additional tests to verify the new behavior and ensure that the change does not introduce regressions. There should be tests for both the new and old serialization formats.
